## Activity

During June 2020, Market Eye Clinic completed 150 captures. This activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. The capture total is recorded for the site and month under review and supports monitoring of routine service performance.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 4 sets were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.7 per cent of captures. The result should be considered alongside the total activity recorded for June 2020. It identifies the images that could not proceed through grading and provides a measure for ongoing review of image acquisition and submission processes.

## Grading

Grading identified 15 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 days. This measure records the time between image capture and completion of grading and supports oversight of the reporting pathway. The activity, image-quality and grading results should be reviewed together when assessing site operations at Market Eye Clinic.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
